description: Analyzes a contract or legal document. Identifies key parties, contract type (NDA, SaaS, employment, etc.), important dates (effective, termination, renewal), key obligations per party, liability clauses and limits, termination conditions, and governing law/jurisdiction. Returns a structured summary.

document_text.description: The full text of the contract or legal document to analyze.

document_type.description: Type of document. If omitted, the type is auto-detected from the content.

name: analyze_contract
